top_signals.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Glut Swamps Storage in Top-Growing State
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s swelling palm oil inventories are straining storage capacity in the country’s top-producing state, as a bumper harvest piles pressure on the government to clear excess supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
